method: Todoist: named tasks 'ZZ probe today' (created undated, then dated via quick option) and 'ZZ probe undated' via Quick Add, opened via task detail's Date button. meologue: fixtures seeded through the store (taskStore.upsert), titled 'ZZ probe undated' and 'ZZ probe today' (date=2026-09-13), opened via each row's 'Date "title"' button.

SCHED-02.row: Quick options in order, on an undated task, Sunday 13 Sep 2026

todoist.note: 'Next week' is DROPPED entirely -- not merged, not shown twice -- because it would resolve to the same Monday 14 Sep as Tomorrow.

meologue.note: meologue keeps all 4 quick options even though 'Next week' (Mon 14 Sep) and 'Tomorrow' (Mon 14 Sep, since tomorrow IS Monday) resolve to the identical calendar date. It neither drops nor merges the duplicate.

SCHED-02.difference: On a Sunday where tomorrow is Monday, Todoist drops the redundant 'Next week' quick option (3 options shown); meologue always shows all 4 quick options regardless of date collisions (4 options shown, with Next week and Tomorrow both reading Mon 14 Sep).

SCHED-03.row: 'Today' quick option absent, 'No Date' present, once the task is already due today
SCHED-03.note: Both apps drop 'Today' and show 'No Date' once the task is already due today. This is the fix the ledger called for (meologue previously still listed 'Today' with todayOptionHiddenBecauseCurrentDate:false).

SCHED-07.row: Today's calendar cell, on a weekend day (Sunday 13 Sep 2026)
SCHED-07.note: meologue now renders the exact same rgb(226,106,96) bold red as Todoist on a weekend today-cell. This is the fix (meologue previously rendered grey rgb(204,204,204) because the weekend muted-foreground utility won the cascade over the today-color utility). Neither app sets aria-current.
